notes.title: BitMaster v3.0.3 Update [PC/Mac]
notes.notes:
- New: Shortcuts. They allow you to start the game from 10th wave with randomized guns. This feature activates for a specific hero after he/she defeats a boss
- Fixed some Russian translations
- Cosmetic improvements
